ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Permission.SW_Bypass_Validation_Rules <> TRUE, ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Unqualified"), OR( ISPICKVAL(SW_Unqualified_Reason__c, ""), ISPICKVAL(SW_Unqualified_Subcategory__c, ""), ISBLANK(SW_Unqualified_Reason_Notes__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill Unqualified Reason, Unqualified Subcategory and Unqualified Reason Notes before moving the status to Unqualified.
